all_candidates.topic: Does new UPI policy ensure fair long-term digital payment growth?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Finance clarified on August 8, 2026, that UPI users will continue to make payments without transaction charges, and any future Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) would be limited and threshold-based, not blanket.

all_candidates.topic: Should the government intervene to lower petrol/diesel prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government stated on August 10, 2026, that it has no direct role in deciding petrol and diesel prices as rates are market-driven.

all_candidates.topic: Will free online coaching reduce exam stress?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Prime Minister Modi announced free online coaching for competitive examinations during his Independence Day address on August 15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will AI skilling initiatives effectively prepare youth for future jobs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: PM Modi announced an AI skilling initiative for one crore youth during his Independence Day speech on August 15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI truly creating more jobs than it displaces in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report released around August 7-11, 2026, stated that AI is creating more jobs in India than it is cutting.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI professionals in India overly concerned about job security?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A survey released around August 7-10, 2026, indicated that 66% of AI workers in India expect layoffs in the next 3-6 months.

all_candidates.topic: Are biometric verification systems truly inclusive for all Indians?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A viral video on August 13, 2026, showed a Naga man struggling with biometric KYC, sparking debate about technology's inclusiveness for diverse features.

all_candidates.topic: Is the government's UPI merchant fee plan sustainable?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government stated on August 8, 2026, that the vast majority of UPI merchant transactions will remain free, with potential nominal, threshold-based MDR only for a limited category.

all_candidates.topic: Should monthly LPG price revisions be linked to international crude?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Oil marketing companies revised LPG cylinder prices effective August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should exam answer keys be released earlier for faster results?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The National Testing Agency announced on August 14, 2026, that the provisional answer keys for UGC NET June 2026 will be released on August 16, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Do new Tatkal booking rules improve ticket availability for common users?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways revised its Tatkal Ticket booking rules and procedural updates from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should Delhi mandate phasing out new petrol/diesel vehicle registrations?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi Electric Vehicles Policy, effective July 1, 2026 (mentioned Aug 14, 2026), sets mandates for phasing out new ICE vehicle registrations from 2027/2028.

all_candidates.topic: Should India consistently adjust windfall tax on fuel exports?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Indian government increased windfall tax on petrol, diesel, and ATF exports on August 3, 2026, and then cut the petrol export levy to nil from August 15, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is the current UPSC exam schedule fair to all aspirants?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Union Public Service Commission released UPSC Mains admit cards on August 15, 2026, with exams scheduled from August 21-30, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are new GST e-invoicing rules beneficial for small businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New GST Rules, effective August 1, 2026, mandate "Ship-to GSTIN" for applicable e-Invoicing and e-Way Bill transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Do new banking rules truly simplify KYC and credit card usage?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Major changes to banking rules, including CKYC 2.0 and credit card reward restructuring, became effective from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should the Centre restrict states from taxing mineral rights?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026, passed by Parliament on August 13, 2026, restricts states from imposing new taxes on mineral rights.

all_candidates.topic: Will new Central Labour Codes benefit both employees and businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Central Rules under India's four Labour Codes were enacted on May 8, 2026, setting new compliance requirements for employers (discussed Aug 14, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Will new tax reforms truly boost foreign investment in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The "Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026" was introduced on August 4, 2026, proposing tax changes to attract foreign investment and boost manufacturing.

all_candidates.topic: Should India prioritize semiconductor manufacturing over other industries?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Prime Minister Modi, in his Independence Day speech on August 15, 2026, highlighted India's progress in building domestic semiconductor capabilities.
